Intercropping timber with annual crops can be a viable option for farmers in the Philippine upland.

the costs and benefits of growing trees intercropped with food crops depend on tree density and the duration of the intercropped period, and the benefits of intercropped timber trees are greatest when the trees are grown with food crops that have a high value relative to the trees, and where land is abundant relative to labor.

the economic feasibility of intercropping fast-growing timber with food crops.
understanding the biophysical and economic trade-offs of intercropping fast-growing timber trees with food and fiber crops in the Philippines uplands.

intercropping of timber trees with food crop is an economically attractive option in upland areas of the Philippines, but only if the farmer is willing to accept a 10% reduction in annual food production.
the results of the present study show that intercropping of timber trees with food and cash crops in the uplands is not a profitable option for farmers.
intercropping is not a profitable alternative to sole cropping of either component.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
intercropping trees and annuals is not a panacea, but that it is a viable option in some circumstances.

the economic benefits from intercropping food crops with trees in Mindanao are likely to be small, but that the benefits are likely to increase as the value of the trees increase relative to the food crops.
the benefits of intercropped falcataria trees are not likely to offset the cost of reduced food production in the short-term.
The main takeaway from our work is that
intercropping timber trees with foodcrops can be an economically attractive option for smallholders in tropical forest margins.
intercropping can be an attractive option for farmers who are seeking to diversify their land use and to increase their income from timber.
intercropping trees is a viable alternative for upland farmers in Mindanao, but only if the value of timber exceeds that of food crops and the opportunity cost of labor is high.
